entries.en:
Convinced of the merits of Qitarl Natl's argument, you express your support for his theory of Ronkan subjugation of the Qitari, a vote of confidence that pleases the Qitari steward greatly. Grudgingly agreeing that his father may have a point, the Qitari youngling Chaqurl Qhotl agrees to assist in the restoration of the first stela.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

entries.en: Under your watchful eye, the Qitari artisans restore the first stela to Qitarl Natl's best interpretation of its former glory. Encouraged and heartened by reclaiming a vital piece of their legacy, the Stewards now pursue their excavation efforts with newfound zeal. Continue to lend them your aid in their efforts should you so desire.
entries.fr: Les Qitari du plateau de Hopl célèbrent la restauration de leur stèle légendaire. Mais ce n'est qu'une première partie, les fouilles continuent encore afin de déterrer le passé de leur peuple !
entries.ja: ルリの発掘隊のキタリたちは、「第一の石碑」の復元完了を、とても喜んでいるようだ。これからも、キタリ族の発掘を手伝っていこう！

entries.en: Weathered as they are, the meaning behind the engravings on the first stela are quite clear. The first Ronkan emperor subjugated our ancestors by force and conscripted them into service.
entries.fr: souuutenir théorie de Qitarl Natl ?  aussi penser que Ronka asservir Qitari ?

entries.en: There can be no doubting this. Surely you agree that my theory is far more logical than the faerie tale proposed by my son, yes?
entries.fr: Qitarl Natl persuadé que stèle raconter première rencontre de Qitari et Ronka. Ronka manier grande épée, signifier grande puuuissance militaire, et Ronka assujettir Qitari comme vassaux.
entries.ja:
「第一の石碑」は、初代皇帝とキタリの遭遇の記憶。
皇帝は、剣が象徴する武力によって、
キタリ族を制圧し、ロンカの支配下においたに違いないでござる！

entries.en: If you elect to vouch for Qitarl Natl's theory, the stela will be restored to reflect his interpretation of history. Proceed, and you will be unable to view the stela as Chaqurl Qhotl envisions it.
entries.fr: Si vous choisissez de soutenir la théorie de Qitarl Natl, la stèle des Qitari sera restaurée selon cette hypothèse. Vous ne pourrez pas voir la version proposée par Chaqurl Qhotl.
entries.ja:
「キタルリ・ナトル」の説を信じてストーリーを進行させると、
彼の説に基づき、石碑の復元が行われるようです。
「チャクルリ・コテル」の説での復元結果を見ることはできません。

entries.en: The rewards you receive and the content of the quests to follow will be the same regardless of the choice you make. You are free to choose the version of history you find most compelling.
entries.fr: Les récompenses que vous obtiendrez seront les mêmes dans les deux cas. Suivez donc vos convictions pour faire ce choix.

entries.en: Protected by the talisman fashioned for them by the Night's Blessed and heartened by rediscovering a piece of their heritage, the Stewards now pursue their excavation efforts with newfound zeal. Should you choose, continue to aid them in their cause.
entries.fr: Les Qitari du plateau de Hopl, protégés par le talisman du peuple de la Nuit et soutenus par vos contributions, redoublent d'efforts afin d'explorer la caverne de leurs ancêtres et d'y trouver tous les secrets qu'elle renferme.
entries.ja:
ルリの発掘隊のキタリたちは、夜の民の護符と、
蘇った石碑の姿に励まされ、ますます発掘に打ち込んでいるようだ！
これからも発掘に協力し、洞窟遺跡での新たな発見に期待しよう！
